digest.component_or_area: store auto-push and ticket event persistence
propositions: An auto-push rejection caused by GitHub push protection is silently misclassified as a transient non-fast-forward conflict, causing the push to be retried futilely three times while the rejection reason is discarded and the caller sees only a generic retry-count message, leaving the branch diverged and the incident invisible.

The push-pending divergence signal (PUSH_PENDING) is computed only from the fsck pull path and never consulted by any write path, so rejection warnings are byte-identical across multiple writes and the growing backlog of unpushed commits is never re-announced, explaining eight-hour detection latency.

Ticket comment payloads are never scanned for secrets on write despite being a documented vector where raw environment output is routinely pasted, leaving credentials undetected even after GitHub push protection rejects a commit containing them.
